purpose: Test whether terrestrial Palearctic insect species that share modeled Last Glacial Maximum refugial geography show more concordant present-day post-IBD genetic break geography.

provenance_boundary.interpretation: This is a fresh, outcome-shielded secondary analysis, not a new never-opened confirmatory dataset. The aggregate 211-species Phase-4 result is already known, but species eligibility and LGM predictor qualification are frozen before constructing or inspecting the new pairwise genetic-concordance response.

taxonomy.rationale: Restrict to predominantly terrestrial holometabolous insect orders and avoid obligately aquatic immature-stage orders represented in the parent panel.

palearctic_membership.boundary_rule: point intersects a polygon whose REALM equals Palearctic
palearctic_membership.missing_or_unassigned_points: count in denominator and not as Palearctic

dyadic_split.reason: The parent split is irrelevant to the new pairwise historical question and is imbalanced in the response-blind feasibility pre-screen.
dyadic_split.rule: After the authoritative eligible species list is fixed, sort species by SHA256('palearctic-holometabola-lgm-v0.1|'+species); assign the lower floor(n/2) to source and the remainder to target.
dyadic_split.primary_dyads: complete source x target bipartite panel
dyadic_split.post_sdm_policy: Keep the frozen source/target assignment; drop ineligible species in place without resplitting or taxonomic balancing.

response_blind_feasibility_prescreen.rule: conservative coordinate-box approximation to core Palearctic, applied before any species-pair genetic response inspection
response_blind_feasibility_prescreen.interpretation: The program is not obviously sample-size-infeasible; the authoritative Ecoregions2017 screen still must be run.

lgm_sdm.occurrence_source: GBIF external occurrence records, independent of the genetic response

climate.rationale: Same four broad thermal/precipitation axes already fixed in the response-blind TTF historical-climate program.

accessible_area.definition: 1000-km geodesic buffer around the convex hull of thinned current occurrences, intersected with terrestrial cells
accessible_area.background_selection: all eligible 0.25-degree Palearctic grid cells inside M if <=10000, otherwise first 10000 by SHA256('palearctic-lgm-bg-v0.1|species|cell_index')

model.family: regularized presence-background logistic species distribution model
model.features: linear plus quadratic standardized climate terms
model.regularization_strength_selection: spatial-block cross-validation on current-climate occurrences only
model.regularization_selection: maximum mean five-fold spatial-block ROC-AUC; tie -> smallest C (strongest regularization)
model.spatial_blocks: KMeans(k=5, random_state=20260929) on presence ECEF coordinates; assign background cells to nearest presence-cluster centroid
model.feature_standardization: mean and population SD of the four current-climate variables across the species accessible-area background cells; then linear z terms plus z^2 terms
model.final_fit: all current presences plus deterministic accessible-area background with selected C

projection.binary_refugium_threshold: 10th percentile training-presence suitability, used only for sensitivity analysis
projection.primary_pairwise_refugial_relation: Schoener D between normalized continuous 21-ka suitability surfaces on the union analysis grid
projection.sensitivity_pairwise_relation: Jaccard overlap of thresholded 21-ka refugial cells

projection_grid.cell_reference: cell centres on a fixed longitude/latitude grid anchored at -180,-90
projection_grid.mask: cell centre must be inside the frozen Palearctic realm polygon and finite in all four current plus all four 21-ka climate rasters
projection_grid.rationale: Fit/extract climate at native CHELSA resolution but compare broad-scale refugial suitability on a common tractable geography.

lgm_sdm.current_relation: Schoener D between normalized predicted current-climate suitability surfaces on the fixed Palearctic projection grid
lgm_sdm.present_geographic_opportunity: Jaccard overlap of the two species' 1000-km accessible-area masks on the fixed Palearctic projection grid

climate_validity.presence_rule: all four current variables finite at a retained occurrence
climate_validity.projection_rule: a Palearctic grid cell is retained only when all four current and all four 21-ka variables are finite

ttf_q_qualification.endpoint_identity: exact source and target species fixed effects
baseline_controls: current-climate niche similarity constructed with the same SDM machinery
ttf_q_qualification.nested_geography_step: present geographic opportunity is added last and its incremental information survival is reported separately

detectability.rule: Report evaluable MDE only at nuisance amplitudes whose beta=0 Wilson 95% upper bound is <=0.05.

ttf_q_qualification.go_rule: Open the new pairwise genetic-concordance response only if the authoritative panel has >=30 species, the LGM relation retains non-zero variation after declared controls, no single source or target contributes >=0.15 of residual signal mass, and at least one nuisance amplitude has an evaluable grid MDE <=0.10.
ttf_q_qualification.no_go_rule: If any mandatory GO condition fails, close as NOT_EVALUABLE_LGM_PALEARCTIC_INSECT_PANEL and do not construct the pairwise genetic-concordance response.

future_genetic_response_if_qualified.primary_response: symmetric pairwise concordance of post-IBD genetic differentiation geography
future_genetic_response_if_qualified.construction: For each ordered species pair, train the already frozen genetic TTF spatial kernel on species i alone and score held-out post-IBD edge turnover in species j; combine i->j and j->i by arithmetic mean for an unordered pair.
future_genetic_response_if_qualified.pair_inclusion: both directional scores must be computable under the frozen endpoint-safe IBD and genetic graph rules
future_genetic_response_if_qualified.primary_test: Does LGM refugial similarity positively predict symmetric genetic-geography concordance after the declared response-blind controls?
future_genetic_response_if_qualified.species_endpoint_dependence: two-way cluster-robust by the two species endpoints
not_allowed: change the panel after pairwise response inspection
change LGM SDM variables or thresholds after pairwise response inspection
replace the LGM predictor after a null result
reinterpret the parent 211-species Phase-4 test as confirmatory evidence for this new historical hypothesis
